def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    markers=[(r,c) for r in range(h-1) for c in range(w-1)
             if grid[r][c]==grid[r+1][c]==grid[r][c+1]==grid[r+1][c+1]==0]
    if not markers: return out
    r,c=markers[0]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if (i in (r,r+1) or j in (c,c+1)) and out[i][j]!=2:
                out[i][j]=0
    return out
